title: Self-Refine and CRITIC — Genuinely Converging a Draft, and Genuinely Confirming Self-Critique Misses Facts Tools Catch
titleKn: Self-Refine ಮತ್ತು CRITIC — ಒಂದೂ Draft ಅನ್ನೂ ನಿಜವಾಗಿ ಒಮ್ಮುಖಗೊಳಿಸುವುದೂ
desc: Genuinely run a self-refine loop that converges a weak first draft to a stronger one in one iteration, then genuinely confirm the critical limitation: internal self-critique alone misses a real factual error that CRITIC-style tool verification catches immediately.
objectives: Genuinely run a self-refine loop that starts with a weak draft, critiques it, and produces an improved draft that converges to zero issues.
Genuinely confirm the exact iteration count needed for convergence on this task.
Genuinely confirm that internal self-critique alone finds zero issues with a factually wrong claim.
Genuinely confirm that adding one external tool lookup (CRITIC-style verification) catches that same factual error immediately.
Explain why Self-Refine improves style/completeness but cannot verify truth, while CRITIC specifically closes that gap.

    return VerificationResult(passed=True, issues=[], evidence={"source": "self-judgment, no execution"})

from dataclasses import dataclass, field

@dataclass
class VerificationResult:
    passed: bool
    issues: list = field(default_factory=list)
    evidence: dict = field(default_factory=dict)

def self_feedback(code):
    # self-feedback: the model judges its own code with no external check
    # a model that wrote a buggy comparison is prone to approving that same bug
    return VerificationResult(passed=True, issues=[], evidence={"source": "self-judgment, no execution"})

def grounded_feedback(code):
    # tool-grounded: actually execute the code and check against a real spec
    ns = {}
    try:
        exec(code, ns)
        result = ns["is_even"](7)
        expected = False
        if result != expected:
            return VerificationResult(
                passed=False,
                issues=[f"is_even(7) returned {result}, expected {expected}"],
                evidence={"source": "executed test case", "ran": "is_even(7)"},
            )
        return VerificationResult(passed=True, evidence={"source": "executed test case"})
    except Exception as e:
        return VerificationResult(passed=False, issues=[str(e)], evidence={"source": "execution error"})

buggy_code = "def is_even(n):\n    return n % 2 == 1  # bug: this checks odd, not even"

self_check = self_feedback(buggy_code)
grounded_check = grounded_feedback(buggy_code)

print("Self-feedback result:   ", self_check)
print("Grounded-feedback result:", grounded_check)
print()
print("This demonstrates the blind-spot problem: self-feedback approved the SAME")

    return {"passed": tests_passed == total, "score": tests_passed / total}

    print("  STOP: max_iterations reached")
